title: Agent Loop metrics event
description: Authored here (#20). One line of .agent-loop/metrics.jsonl, written by scripts/agent-loop-supervisor and summarized by scripts/agent-loop-report. Times are Unix epoch seconds.

event.description: supervisor_start/supervisor_exit: the Supervisor process; session_start: a session was launched; nudge; stall: nudges failed, an agent-loop-stall issue was filed and the session restarted; restart: the context restart (pct set); shutoff: no work, the session was ended; delivered: an issue this machine claimed closed as completed (issue and seconds set); unclaimed: an issue this machine claimed lost its machine label.

seconds.description: delivered: from first seeing the claim to the close.
